studies.title: Drawing steps and resolution
studies.description: Build fourteen churches and every capital letter from rough guides, then lower positional precision. Compare five resolutions while retaining checked symmetry, repeated counts and relative order.

studies.title: Line art evidence
studies.description: Inspect every capital letter together, then explore church drawings. Hover over lines, joints and boundaries to see shared sites, repeated structure and what remains unknown.
